info.title: Inference Hub API
info.description: Products, services and news of the inference market.

get.summary: Liveness and database connectivity.

parameters.description: Keep offerings of this GPU type, such as `H100 SXM` (case-insensitive).

get.summary: Latest token prices of every model at every provider.
get.description:
`blended_per_mtok` weighs input and output 3:1, a common chat workload, so
models can be ranked by one number.

parameters.name: open_weights
parameters.description: Keep models with open weights.

parameters.name: maker
parameters.description: Keep models made by this organization (slug).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Keep offerings from this provider (slug).

parameters.name: min_context
parameters.description: Keep models with at least this context window, in tokens.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default `blended`, cheapest first.

get.summary: Open-source projects by GitHub stars, archived ones last.
Headline numbers, the most traded GPUs and models, and source health.
GPU types across every cloud: min, median and max price per GPU-hour.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text the GPU type or model id must contain (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: min_providers
parameters.description: Keep rows sold by at least this many providers. Default 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Most rows to return. Default 100, at most 500.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description:
Keep models (or GPUs) this organization sells, by slug. Prices and
provider counts still cover the whole market.

parameters.name: maker
parameters.description: Models only: keep this maker (as providers name it, such as `deepseek-ai`).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description:
Lowest price at most / at least this: USD per 1M tokens (blend) for
models, USD per GPU-hour for GPUs.

parameters.name: min_context
parameters.description: Models only: context window of at least this many tokens.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
`providers` (default), `price`, `median`, `input`, `output`,
`context` or `name`.

parameters.name: dir
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`; each sort has a natural default.

parameters.name: caps
parameters.description:
Models only: keep those with every listed capability, comma-separated,
such as `tools,in:image`.

Everything one provider sells, collected from its catalog and from the

get.summary:
Search organizations, products, models (chat and media), GPU types and
news at once. Results come grouped by kind, best match first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text to search for (at least 2 characters).

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Only these kinds, comma-separated, such as `model,gpu`.

parameters.name: per_kind
parameters.description: Results per kind. Default 6, at most 50.

AdapterStatus.description: Health of one market adapter, for the admin view.

listings_seen.description: Listings the last successful run saw.

mapped.description: Of which mapped to a product of the directory.

Category.description: A node of the market taxonomy, such as "GPU Clouds".

organization_count.description: Number of organizations listed in this category.

ErrorBody.description: Error body returned by every failing endpoint.

FailedJob.description: A job that failed every attempt.

FundingRound.description: A funding round as shown on the company's page.

gpu_types.description: GPU types with a current offering, for filters.

GpuIndexRow.description: One GPU type across every cloud: price per GPU-hour.

GpuPrice.description: A row of the GPU price comparison: one configuration at one provider.

price_per_gpu_hour.description: Price per hour divided by the number of GPUs.

HoldResolution.description: An editor's decision on a held price.

KindCount.description: How many items a provider sells of each kind, for tabs.

MakerCount.description: A maker and how many models it has, for filters.

MakerRef.description: The organization that makes a product, read from `maker_*` columns.

MarketDetail.description: Every provider's price for one model or GPU type.

MarketListing.description: One provider's live price for a model or GPU, as the adapter saw it.

capabilities.description: What this provider says the model can do.

unit.description: Non-chat models: what the price is per, and the price.

variant.description: Reseller detail: the hosting provider behind a router, or a region or plan.

MarketOverview.description: Headline numbers of the whole market.

distinct_models.description: Distinct models across providers, by normalized id.

gpu_index.description: The most widely sold GPUs, for the headline index.

gpu_listings.description: Live GPU configurations with an hourly price.

media_listings.description:
Live listings of models priced per unit (embedding, image, video,
speech, transcription), and the distinct models among them.

multi_provider_models.description: Of which sold by two or more providers: the comparable market.

providers.description: Organizations with at least one live listing.

updated_at.description: When the freshest listing was last seen.

MarketProvider.description: A provider in the market leaderboard.

cheapest_count.description: GPU types or models sold by two or more providers where this one is cheapest.

media_models.description: Embedding, image, video, speech and transcription models.

model_listings.description: Chat model listings as the provider lists them, variants included.

models.description:
Distinct chat models with a price (variants such as `:free` or
`@region` count once; models only offered free are left out).

MarketSource.description: One data source of the market: a provider's adapter and its health.

kind.description: `model` or `gpu`; `None` before the first successful run.

MediaIndexRow.description: One non-chat model across providers: its unit price.

unit.description:
What the price is per: `mtok_input`, `image`, `video_second`,
`character` or `audio_second`.

ModelIndexRow.description: One model across every provider: price per million tokens.

capabilities.description:
What providers say it can do: `in:<modality>`, `out:<modality>` and
features (`tools`, `json`, `reasoning`, `web`, `caching`).

min_blended_per_mtok.description: Cheapest 3:1 blend of input and output.

model_key.description: Normalized id shared by providers, such as `deepseek-v3.2`.

name.description: A display name: the most common name providers give it.

ModelPrice.description: A row of the model price comparison: one model at one provider, latest price.

blended_per_mtok.description:
Price of 3 input tokens per output token, per million tokens: a single
number for sorting chat-style workloads.

maker.description: The lab that makes the model.

ModelPriceSort.description: Sort orders of the model comparison.

active_params_b.description: Parameters active per token, in billions (mixture-of-experts models).

NewsEnrichment.description:
An LLM's triage of a news item. A suggestion for editors; `summary_ai` is
machine-written and must be shown labelled as such.

NewsItem.description: A news item as shown in feeds.

oneOf.description: The LLM's triage of the item, when it was enriched.

NewsMatch.description: How a news item was linked to an organization.

NewsMention.description: An organization a news item is about.

NewsStatus.description: Review state of a news item. Only approved items are public.

Offering.description: The latest observation of a provider selling a product.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the prices.

observed_at.description: When this price was last checked: first seen, or last confirmed by an adapter.

OrgKind.description: The roles an organization plays in the market. One organization can hold several.

Organization.description: An organization as shown in listings.

funding.description: Rounds the organization raised, newest first.

links.description: Named external links, such as `github`, `x` or `docs`.

portfolio.description: Companies the organization invested in, most recent first.

served_products.description: Products made by others that the organization sells or serves.

OrganizationDetail.description: The full profile of an organization.

OrganizationRef.description: A short reference to an organization, embedded in product and offering responses.

logo_url.description: Path of the organization's logo, such as `/logos/openai.svg`.

Page_MediaIndexRow.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: One non-chat model across providers: its unit price.

unit.description:
What the price is per: `mtok_input`, `image`, `video_second`,
`character` or `audio_second`.

Page_ModelIndexRow.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: One model across every provider: price per million tokens.

capabilities.description:
What providers say it can do: `in:<modality>`, `out:<modality>` and
features (`tools`, `json`, `reasoning`, `web`, `caching`).

min_blended_per_mtok.description: Cheapest 3:1 blend of input and output.

model_key.description: Normalized id shared by providers, such as `deepseek-v3.2`.

name.description: A display name: the most common name providers give it.

Page_NewsItem.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: A news item as shown in feeds.

oneOf.description: The LLM's triage of the item, when it was enriched.

Page_Organization.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: An organization as shown in listings.

Page_ProductSummary.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: A product as shown in listings.

organization.description: The organization that makes the product.

Page_UnmappedListing.description: One page of results plus the total count across all pages.

items.description: A listing an adapter saw that no product is mapped to yet.

external_id.description: The id to put under the product's `listings:` in the data.

PortfolioCompany.description: A company an investor backed, with the rounds it joined.

PriceHold.description: A price an adapter reported that failed a sanity check, waiting for an editor.

PricePoint.description: One observation of a provider's price for a product, for price history.

configuration.description: Distinguishes configurations of one provider, such as `8× H100 SXM` or a region.

metadata.description: Attributes specific to the product type.

oneOf.description: Present when the product is a model.

offerings.description: Where the product can be bought, one entry per provider and configuration.

oneOf.description: GitHub stats, for products with a synced repository.

ProductDetail.description: The full page of a product.

ProductSummary.description: A product as shown in listings.

organization.description: The organization that makes the product.

ProductType.description: What kind of thing a product is.

ProviderOffering.description: One thing a provider sells: its price next to the market's.

item_key.description: The market key: a model key, or a GPU type.

market_providers.description: Providers selling it, and the market's lowest and median price.

price.description:
The provider's lowest price: blended USD per 1M tokens for chat models,
USD per GPU-hour for GPUs, USD per `unit` for the rest.

product_slug.description: The curated product page, when editors mapped this item.

sources.description: `adapter` (collected from the provider) and/or `curated` (the data files).

variants.description: Listings of this item at the provider: variants, regions, sizes.

ProviderOfferings.description: A provider's offerings, one page, with counts per kind.

RepoLeader.description: A row of the open-source leaderboard.

RepoStats.description: Latest GitHub stats of an open-source product.

stars_30d.description: Stars gained over the last 30 days of recorded history, when there is any.

updated.description: Items that exist and were set.

href.description: The site path of the result, such as `/organizations/openai`.

score.description: Higher is better; exact and prefix matches score above substrings.

subtitle.description: A short second line: maker, kind, price or source.

SearchResults.description: Results grouped by kind, best first, with how many of each matched.

organizations.description: Slugs of the organizations the item is about. Unknown slugs are rejected.

SitemapIndex.description: Every page-worthy slug, for building the sitemap.

SourceStatus.description: A feed source with its fetch health, for the admin view.

organization_slug.description: The organization that owns the feed, if any.

UnmappedListing.description: A listing an adapter saw that no product is mapped to yet.

external_id.description: The id to put under the product's `listings:` in the data.
